VERID_E_STATE_PROTECTED: Reading or writing verid state is not allowed ({target}). Only verid writes state, and it holds the override confirmation code.
VERID_E_SECRET_PROTECTED: Reading or writing secret files is not allowed ({target}).
VERID_E_TRANSCRIPT_PROTECTED: Accessing Claude Code transcripts is not allowed ({target}).
VERID_E_MANIFEST_PROTECTED: The agent may not change the verid manifest ({target}). Only the developer edits this file.
VERID_E_BASH_NESTED_CLAUDE: Starting a nested Claude Code session is not allowed ({target}).
VERID_E_PAYLOAD: Invalid hook payload ({detail}). verid blocks to stay safe.
VERID_E_INTERNAL: verid internal error ({detail}). verid blocks to stay safe.
VERID_E_STATE_MISSING: verid state not found at {path}. There is no `verid init` yet: the developer should create this file containing {"schemaVersion":1}. Until then every tool call is blocked.
VERID_E_STATE_CORRUPT: verid state is corrupt ({path}). The developer must inspect and fix this file outside the agent.
VERID_E_STATE_VERSION: verid state has an unsupported schemaVersion ({path}). verid does not guess its shape; the developer must handle it outside the agent.
VERID_E_LOCK_TIMEOUT: Could not acquire the state lock within {ms} ms ({path}). verid blocks to stay safe; try again.
VERID_E_OVERRIDE_UNATTENDED: Only a developer typing in an interactive session can create an override. Prompts from subagents or `claude -p` sessions are rejected.
VERID_E_OVERRIDE_USAGE: Usage: `/verid allow <reason>` to request an exception for the action that was just blocked, then `/verid confirm <code>` to accept the risk.
VERID_E_OVERRIDE_NOTHING: Nothing was just blocked, or no warning is pending, in this session to override.
VERID_E_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN: {rule} is an invariant and cannot be overridden ({target}). The developer must do this outside the agent.
VERID_E_OVERRIDE_BAD_CODE: Wrong confirmation code. No override was created.
VERID_E_OVERRIDE_STALE: The blocked action changed since the warning. The old warning was cancelled; type `/verid allow <reason>` again.
hint.overridable: Next step: find another valid way. If this action is really needed, ask the developer; only the developer can override with `/verid allow <reason>`.
hint.not_overridable: This is an invariant and cannot be overridden. If needed, the developer must do it outside the agent.
override.risk_warning: RISK WARNING. You are about to let the agent bypass rule {rule} exactly once for: {tool} {target}. Reason: {reason}. The override works once, for this exact action only, and is recorded in the audit log. To accept the risk, type: /verid confirm {code}
override.created: verid: the developer allowed {tool} {target} exactly once. Retry exactly that action, unchanged. Every other action is still blocked.
prompt.hook_failed: verid failed while handling the prompt ({detail}). The prompt was still sent; no override was created.
